is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.s. (page 4, Methods).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping for Vgsc-L995S, Vgsc-L995F, Cyp4j5-L43F, and Coeae1d (Table 1, page 7).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 1 (page 7) provides genotype counts (RR, RS, SS) and frequencies for field and colony populations.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from 12 households in Busia District, Uganda (page 4, Methods).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study establishing a colony and performing bioassays and gene expression analysis.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Field collection occurred between 01st October and 19th November 2018 (page 4, Methods).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes the establishment of a new colony (BusiaUG) from field collections in 2018.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype data is provided in Table 1 of the main text.

assessment.summary: This study characterizes a new Anopheles gambiae s.s. colony (BusiaUG) established from field-collected mosquitoes in Busia, Uganda. It reports high levels of pyrethroid resistance, genotypes for kdr (L995S/F) and metabolic markers (Cyp4j5-L43F, Coeae1d), and investigates gene expression profiles associated with PBO-pyrethroid resistance.
